title: Apply live-smoke hardening for OAuth scopes and sync warning classification
rationale: Real OAuth/live smoke against Google Health showed two production blockers for maintainer approval: (1) login requested the disallowed cloud-platform scope, causing DISALLOWED_OAUTH_SCOPES 403 responses for every sync call; (2) account/linkage and datatype-action preconditions were surfaced as hard sync failures, making first-run behavior rough even when auth succeeded. This patch removes the disallowed scope and classifies known Google Health 400 preconditions as warning-path outcomes.

changes.summary: Removed https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform from OAuth login scope list.
changes.validated_outcome: Live re-auth no longer produces DISALLOWED_OAUTH_SCOPES; token issuance succeeds with health scopes only.

changes.summary: Extended isSyncAccessWarning to treat ACCOUNT_NOT_LINKED and UNSUPPORTED_DATA_TYPE_ACTION API reasons as warning-class sync outcomes.
changes.validated_outcome: Sync emits warning semantics for known account/datatype preconditions instead of immediate hard-fail classification.

changes.summary: Added unit tests for Google Health-specific warning classification branches.
changes.validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli -count=1 passes, including new regression coverage.
